lines.en: Segment by segment, I arch my way forward.

lines.zh: 髓骨虫巢的壁上，我慢慢爬。
lines.en: Along the marrow-nest wall, I crawl slowly.

lines.zh: 从鱼钩上被钓起来，还在扭。
lines.en: Hooked on a fishing line, I still wriggle.

lines.zh: 我往宿主的体温那边钻。
lines.en: I burrow toward a host's body heat.

lines.zh: 身体太软，只能贴着地走。
lines.en: My body is too soft; I can only hug the ground.

lines.zh: 黏液拖在身后，一道亮线。
lines.en: Slime trails behind me in a bright line.
Perfectly still, waiting for it to grow.

lines.zh: 我缩在卵里，等翅膀长出来。
lines.en: Curled in the egg, waiting for wings.

lines.zh: 我盘在髓骨虫巢的孔里。
lines.en: I coil in a hole of the marrow-bone nest.

lines.zh: 我把自己团成一个小结。
lines.en: I curl myself into a small knot.

lines.zh: 在骨缝里，我慢慢蜕一层。
lines.en: In a bone crevice, I slowly shed a layer.

lines.zh: 我等着长成渊蝇的那天。
lines.en: I wait for the day I become a void fly.
Beneath the water, only a bit of me shows.

lines.zh: 我从卵壳的破口里挤出半截。
lines.en: I squeeze half of myself out of the egg's break.

lines.zh: 我寄生在卵里，快长大了。
lines.en: I'm parasitic in the egg, nearly grown.

lines.zh: 我从卵里钻出，还没长翅。
lines.en: I just left the egg, my wings not grown.

lines.zh: 我的身子一节节朝你弓起来。
lines.en: My body arches toward you segment by segment.

lines.zh: 我钻进腐肉的褶缝，向你挪。
lines.en: I burrow through the folds of rotten flesh toward you.

lines.zh: 寄生在别的东西里，我才长大。
lines.en: Only inside another host do I grow.

lines.zh: 寄生在骨头里，我往上看。
lines.en: Parasite in bone, I look up.

lines.zh: 我从卵里探出头来看你。
lines.en: I poke my head out of the egg to see you.
You have no shell; easy to burrow into.

lines.zh: 我抬起身子，朝你摆了摆。
lines.en: I lift my body and sway toward you.

lines.zh: 身体软绵绵，疼得我喘不过气！
lines.en: Soft and squishy, it hurts to breathe!
I'm so hurt by this parasitism!
My body is injured, it hurts!

lines.zh: 被踩扁了半节，我还在扭。
lines.en: Half of me crushed, and I still wriggle.

lines.zh: 蠕动在腐肉之间，等待宿主到来。
lines.en: 蠕动 among the rot, waiting for a host.

lines.zh: 悄悄靠近，静待时机寄生。
lines.en: Creep close, waiting for the chance to parasitize.

lines.zh: 你扔的鱼饵，正好是我的晚餐。
lines.en: Your bait, perfect for my meal.

lines.zh: 钻入温暖的血液，享受养分盛宴。
lines.en: 钻入 warm blood, feasting on the nutrients.

lines.zh: 宿主的温度正是我需要的。
lines.en: The host's temperature suits me well.

lines.zh: 从卵中苏醒，寻找寄生机会。
lines.en: Awake from the egg, seeking a host.

lines.zh: 在骨巢中慢慢生长，等待蜕变。
lines.en: Grow in the bone nest, waiting to metamorphose.

lines.zh: 鱼的表象下，暗藏致命诱惑。
lines.en: Beneath the fish, a deadly temptation.

lines.zh: 寄生成功，享用美味佳肴。
lines.en: Parasitism successful, feasting on the host.

lines.zh: 鱼的肚子里，我将获得力量。
lines.en: In the fish's belly, I'll gain strength.
Touching something hard, the body trembles.

lines.zh: 硬物撞击，痛得蜷缩成一团。
lines.en: Hit by something hard, curling in pain.

lines.zh: 坚硬之物，让我的行动受限。
与硬物碰撞，我失去了平衡。
lines.en: Colliding with something hard, I lose balance.

lines.zh: 硬质物体阻止了前进的脚步。

lines.en: Hit by something hard, I retreat.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我四处翻滚，难以站稳。
lines.en: Collisions cause me to roll, struggling to stand.

lines.zh: 硬物冲击，我的身体发出响声。
lines.en: Hard impacts make a sound in my body.

lines.zh: 硬质表面让我无法继续前行。
碰到了坚硬的东西，我改变了方向。

lines.en: Seeking a mate, ready to breed.

lines.zh: 遇到同类，交配的时刻到了。
lines.en: Found a mate, breeding time arrives.

lines.zh: 吸引异性，准备共同孵化。
lines.en: Attract a partner, ready to co-incubate.

lines.zh: 与伴侣结合，孕育下一代。
lines.en: Combine with a partner, to breed the next generation.

lines.zh: 寻找伴侣，开始繁殖过程。
lines.en: Find a mate, starting the breeding process.
Found a female, ready to mate.

lines.zh: 与雌性交配，确保种群延续。
lines.en: Mate with a female, ensuring the survival of the species.
Find a mate, ready to reproduce.
Combine with a partner, to create life.
Waiting for a host in water
I dwell in the egg shell

lines.zh: 锁定了，准备钻进你的皮肤。
lines.en: Locked on; ready to burrow into your skin.
Host soon to be my home
Aiming at the host, ready to parasitize

lines.zh: 寄生寄生，我永恒的宿命
寄生宿主，我唯一的生存之道
lines.en: Parasitize, my only way to survive

lines.zh: 寄生宿主，我的终极目标
lines.en: Parasitize the host, my ultimate goal
Slipping into your collar takes one instant.

lines.zh: 蠕动着身体，发出嘶嘶声。
试图破壳而出，嘶嘶作响。
用嘴咬向敌人，嘶嘶作响。
奋力攻击，发出细弱嘶声。
lines.en: Fights back, making a weak hiss.

lines.zh: 在敌人身上蠕动，发出嘶嘶声。
从敌人体内钻出，嘶嘶作响。
lines.en: Crawls out of the enemy, hissing.

lines.zh: 在敌人体内扭动，嘶嘶作响。
在敌人身体里蠕动，嘶嘶作响。
在水中孵化，发出嘶嘶声。

lines.en: Hatches in the depths of the Abyss.

lines.zh: 在泥泞中孵化，嘶嘶作响。
在黑暗中孵化，嘶嘶作响。
在卵中孵化，发出嘶嘶声。
髓骨虫巢的卵，一起裂开。
lines.en: The marrow-nest eggs split open together.

lines.zh: 寄生效果发作，我钻了出来。
lines.en: The infestation took hold, and I crawled out.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的身体就蜷成圈。
lines.en: One roast of fire and my body curls into a ring.

lines.zh: 爆炸把卵壳震裂，我滚了出来。
lines.en: The blast cracks my eggshell and I roll out.
